items.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995
items.q: [Spiegle and Al perform a few duets.]

ctx.x: I think I’m going to stand though. You still have the camera running?
[Spiegle and Al perform a few duets.]
That was good, even if I have to say so myself.
